messages:
Alex: Kicking off the trial for Acme — can we do a 30m kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PT? Goal: align success criteria, stakeholders, eval prompts, and timeline.
Priya: Ack, 10am PT works for me. Quick note: we'll need traffic shape, sample prompts, and desired latency SLO ahead of time.
Marco (Acme PM): Thanks — 10am is OK. Attendees: me, Jenna (security), Ravi (infra). A couple things up front: data residency question and pricing for POC credits.
Sam: Short checklist to cover in kickoff: datasets & access, eval prompt set (50–200 examples), success metrics (quality + latency + cost), test keys/IP allowlist, rollback plan.
Jenna (Acme Security): Security questions: TLS + mTLS for ingested data? encryption-at-rest? Will logs be retained and for how long? SOC2 scope + DPA required.
Alex: For pricing, we typically offer POC credits + a temporary discount if they convert. I'll follow up with the pricing doc after kickoff.
Priya: Suggested success criteria candidates to confirm during call:
- Quality: mean accept rate >= 85% on a 200-prompt eval set (or acceptance by product reviewers)
- Latency: 95th perc < 500ms for typical interactive loads (confirm qps)
- Cost: target cost per 1k tokens (TBD with Alex)
- Integration: end-to-end demo of prompt->response in staging within 2 weeks
Marco (Acme PM): Those look reasonable. Proposed timeline: 4 weeks total — Week 0 (kickoff + infra), W1 (setup + smoke), W2 (eval), W3 (iterate + tuning), W4 (final metrics + handoff).
Priya: Discovery questions for kickoff — can everyone bring answers if possible:
1) Sample prompt sets (we need at least 50 examples)
2) Expected QPS and peak patterns
3) Any PII/PHI in the data?
4) Allowed retention window for logs and inputs
5) Target models or model size constraints (latency/cost tradeoffs)
6) Any network constraints (IP ranges / VPC)
Alex: I'll send calendar invite and include a pre-kickoff checklist: test API key, S3 upload for prompts, security questionnaire link.
Sam: I'll bring the eval harness and metrics dashboard. Quick config snippet to share during call:
```
model: redwood-3b-quant
max_tokens: 512
stream: true
batching: auto
```
Sam: Also will share a minimal eval script (node/python) and instructions to run locally.
Marco (Acme PM): We'll prepare the prompt set and drop to S3 (will need a temp role). Also confirming: hosted API is fine for POC, we don't require on-prem for now.
Jenna (Acme Security): Hosted is okay but we need auto-delete after 30 days and proof of encryption keys + DPA. Also please confirm no long-term logs retained by default.
Alex: We can add an auto-delete policy for POC (30d). I'll surface the DPA and retention config.
Priya: One enterprise blocker to flag: if customer opts for VPC/private deployment later, lead time ~3 weeks to provision and test. Confirm now if they might need it during POC.
Marco (Acme PM): Not for POC — hosted is fine. We'll re-evaluate for production.
ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invite created for 1798003000 — email invites sent.
Alex: Perfect. I'll send the invite + pre-kickoff packet (security questionnaire link, pricing summary, and the eval template). Anything else to add? :eyes:
Priya: Please ask customer to share at least 50 prompts and a short traffic histogram before the call.
Sam: I'll add the eval link and a short runbook for troubleshooting to the invite.
Marco (Acme PM): We'll have the prompt dump and a short sample dataset ready. Looking forward to it.
Alex: Thanks everyone — see you tomorrow 10:00am PT. :thumbsup:
